claims: ASEAN is a regional intergovernmental organization established in 1967.
ASEAN member countries are Brunei Darussalam, Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar (Burma), Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, and Vietnam.
Timor-Leste was granted full membership in October 2025.
ASEAN Summit is the supreme policy-making body, comprising ASEAN Heads of State or Government.
ASEAN Coordinating Council (ACC) comprises Foreign Ministers.
ASEAN Coordinating Council coordinates the three pillars.
ASEAN Community Pillars are Political-Security Community, Economic Community, Socio-Cultural Community.
ASEAN Secretariat is located in Jakarta, Indonesia.
ASEAN has maintained relative peace for over 30 years.
ASEAN has prevented major conflicts between members.
ASEAN economic bloc has a GDP over $2.9 trillion.
ASEAN has fostered a single market and production base.
English is the main working language of ASEAN, as stated in the ASEAN Charter.
